why: Image 1 is shot at an angle from inside the room, with the armchairs, the artwork on the left wall and the falloff into the dark corners, so it reads like a real bar photographed in its own downlight; its wood niche and speaker stands look solid and grounded. Image 2 is a flat, symmetrical frontal shot that looks staged, and its foreground gives it away as a render: the glowing disc and cups on the side table look fake, the white rectangles stuck on the speakers look like rendering errors, and an unexplained shape is cut off at the right edge.
